prompt:
Animation model sheet and sprite sheet for a classic hand-drawn 2D cartoon adventure game: ten drawings of the same character, inked and painted as traditional animation cels. The first reference image gives the exact layout and the poses: ten figures in two rows of five, all at the same scale, the feet of each row on the same baseline. Figures one to eight (in reading order) are a walk cycle to the right in strict side view; figure nine stands still in side view with both feet flat on the ground; figure ten stands turned three-quarters towards the viewer and looks at the viewer. Copy every pose, the positions of both legs and feet, the arms, the parcel and the satchel, and the place and size of each figure from the first reference; only the drawing changes. The first reference is a plain 3D render: take only the layout and the poses from it, never its 3D shading or its stiff, blocky forms; redraw the figures with lively, rounded, appealing cartoon shapes. The second reference image only shows the costume, the face and the proportions of the character: do not copy its drawing style, its fur texture, its colours' soft shading or its three-view layout.

Drawing technique: traditional ink-and-paint animation cels as in classic hand-drawn cartoons of the 1950s to 1990s. A clean, confident, dark brown-black ink outline of fairly even weight around every shape, a little thicker on the outer silhouette, with gently tapered ends; inner lines only where shapes meet (face stripes, cap brim, vest edge, sleeves, scarf folds, parcel string). Every area is filled with one flat, opaque cel paint colour, and each colour has exactly one darker shadow tone in a hard-edged shadow shape on the side away from the light (light from the upper left). No gradients, no soft shading, no texture, no fur strands, no brush marks, no highlights except one small white catchlight in each eye. Simple, appealing cartoon design: a round head with a clear muzzle, the broad black-and-white stripes of the face as clean graphic shapes, clear eyes (dark pupil with a white catchlight) that read at small size, a stout round body, short legs with simple rounded paws, the scarf as a simple red shape with a few fold lines and no knitting texture. Colours: cap and vest dark green, shirt cream, scarf red, satchel and strap brown, brass buttons, parcel light brown with a cream string, the dark fur a mid charcoal grey that is clearly lighter than the black ink line, the light fur warm white. It must look like a hand-inked and hand-painted animation cel: not a 3D render, not a painting, not a picture-book illustration, not a vector icon.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Each figure isolated on a fully transparent background, with clear empty space between the figures; no ground, no cast shadow, no frame borders, nothing cut off at the edge of the sheet.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Background painting for a classic hand-drawn 2D cartoon, as painted for television cartoons and animated feature films of the 1980s and 1990s: the painted background plate on which flat-painted character cels are laid. Painted by hand in opaque gouache and acrylic on illustration board with soft round brushes. Simplified, designed shapes with a cartoon feel: the cottage crooked and bulging, with a softly sagging roof and a leaning chimney, the lighthouse slightly curved and tapering, rocks like big rounded soft lumps, barrels plump; the perspective slightly exaggerated and playful. Very little texture: walls, roof and paving are suggested with a few loose strokes and soft blended shapes, not every stone is painted; no fine detail, no realistic texture, no photographic lighting. Colour is laid in broad, smooth areas with soft blended transitions and soft edges; the sky a smooth airbrushed gradient with a few simple stylised clouds. Rich, designed dusk palette: a deep blue-violet sky blending into warm orange and pink at the horizon, cool violet shadows, warm yellow lamp light, the sea a deep teal-blue with simple painted orange reflection strokes. Mid to dark values, so that brightly coloured cartoon characters stand out in front of it. No ink outlines, no black contour lines, no cel shading. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a realistic digital matte painting, not a picture-book illustration, not a postcard.

Staging and composition, like the set of a side-view adventure game seen at eye level, slightly from above: the horizon lies at about half the picture height. The stone quay fills the bottom third of the picture across the whole width; its front edge towards the water runs horizontally at about 62 to 66 percent of the picture height. The short wooden jetty starts from the quay edge left of the centre and runs out into the water. The harbour-master's cottage stands at the left edge, cut by the frame, and occupies the left fifth of the picture; its lit window faces the viewer. The lighthouse stands on its rocky headland on the right, at about 80 to 90 percent of the picture width, its top at about 15 percent of the picture height. The iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about 62 percent of the picture width and reaches up to about 40 percent of the picture height. The two barrels, the stack of crates and the coil of rope stand together at the right end of the quay near the right edge, close to the viewer; the barrels are large, about a quarter of the picture height tall. The quay between about 20 and 60 percent of the picture width is free and calm, painted simply with large paving stones and little detail (a character will walk there), and the bottom fifth of the picture is a plain, calm strip of paving.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave these out of this painting, because the game animates them separately as cel layers on top of it: the two fishing boats (leave the water beside the jetty empty and calm), any smoke (the chimney top is clean, no smoke at all), any light beam (the lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing yellow spot without rays), and birds. The lantern glass glows warm yellow with only a faint soft glow around it.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
